description: This file defines a React functional component 'LoginForm' that renders a login form with username/email and password fields, performs client-side validation, displays error messages, and handles mock credential checking.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that both username/email and password fields are filled. Sets error state if validation fails.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, performs validation, checks credentials against mock data, updates success/error states, and calls optional onLogin callback.
